Subject: Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate | Reporting Date: 02 Jan 2025 | Facility: Jeroen Bosch Ziekenhuis, 's-Hertogenbosch

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation for prior PCa diagnosis. PSA 7.3 ng/mL. PI-RADS 5.

FINDINGS:
The gland measures 64.0 mL in total volume. T2 sequences highlight a discrete hypointense area located in the right peripheral zone, spanning the base to mid-gland, with a maximal diameter near 18 mm. High b-value diffusion-weighted imaging confirms prominent restriction, mirrored by low ADC signal. Dynamic contrast phases capture early, localized enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. No seminal vesicle invasion or extraprostatic extension is evident. Pelvic lymph nodes appear benign.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 64.0 mL; PSA density 0.11 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.854789.
